comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Two things.

1. You can pull any job quest, regardless of your current job, so long as you meet the fame and skill requirements.
2. This quest has a strict requirement of r5 Crafts Trading. Not sure why it isn't showing that in the Required Skill pane at the moment.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Lately, several other job quests have been reported as showing up despite players not having the right skill level(s), or having the appropriate skill(s) at all. Either something's changed with recent patches, or everything taught to players previously that "you must have X skill rank to make the job appear" was mistaken.

Note that some jobs do actually require the listed skill rank to complete them via NPC talking. I'm not sure if this is one of them, but it seems now like appropriate port permits, a good dose of fame in the right category (merchant for trade jobs, etc.), and pre-quest/discoveries (if applicable) is all you really need to make job quests like this one appear.

The more we learn, eh? Cheers, and thanks for letting the rest of us know.
